description: I am a data scientist and software engineer based in Nairobi, with a BSc in Software Engineering and experience in Python, SQL, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, AWS, and Tableau. I have built full-stack applications and data pipelines. I am drawn to this challenge because astronaut autonomy depends on interpretable health analytics. I want to contribute personalized baseline modeling, trend and anomaly detection, and a clear dashboard that turns indicators into actionable alerts
